item.title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
item.description: Meta expanded its AI coding offerings with a new agent that, it promises, can handle complex tasks with complex software.

item.title: Klaviyo acquires Elias Torres’ Agency in full-circle reunion for tech founders
item.description: The serial entrepreneur joins the e-commerce company as CPO to lead its AI agents.

item.title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
item.description: The legendary Google executive is joined by other outgoing Google execs in a joint mission to use AI to push forward the process of scientific discovery.

item.title: Shopify says AI search is driving more traffic and sales, not replacing Google
item.description: Shopify says AI isn’t cannibalizing search traffic the way it has for publishers. Instead, AI-driven traffic and orders to Shopify stores tripled year over year in Q2.

item.title: Hark previews its browser use agent for completing tasks
item.description: Hark claims that its browser use agent is faster and cheaper than competition.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s Real World AI Stage features robots, automated factories, and extinct animals
item.description: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.

item.title: Anthropic is hiring an AI chip design team
item.description: Anthropic is building a team for designing its own custom AI chips. The Claude maker said it would co-design hardware and models to help its technology run faster and more efficiently.

item.title: MacPaw taps Liquid AI to offer on-device inference to devs building for its app store
item.description: MacPaw is building a local version of its AI assistant Eney using Liquid AI's models.

item.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
item.description: WindBorne Systems has raised a $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.

item.title: SpaceX has bought $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks so far this year
item.description: The purchase illustrates just how interconnected Elon Musk's universe of companies are.

item.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
item.description: A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.

item.title: Anthropic signs $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta
item.description: Anthropic has been on a cloud partnership spree in recent months, and its latest move is reportedly a $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta.

item.title: Meet Wrinkles, an app that uncovers the hidden stories of the places around you
item.description: Wrinkles, available on both iOS and Android, essentially acts as an AI-powered audio tour guide that reveals hidden history and local stories.

item.title: Nvidia doesn’t mess around: A week after open AI industry group formed, it’s already showing progress
item.description: The week-old Open Secure AI Alliance, spearheaded by Nvidia and grown to over 120 companies, already has proposals out for defending against AI agents.

item.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
item.description: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.

item.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
item.description: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply. But even Texas can be pushed to the brink.

item.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
item.description: An analysis of the last seven years of Tesla earnings calls shows just how little attention Musk pays to Tesla's car business.

item.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
item.description: Apple says its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI has widened. In a new court filing, Apple claims additional former staff may have retained or accessed confidential information.

item.title: Is the future of data centers portable? Runware builds a pod to find out
item.description: On Tuesday, AI infrastructure company Runware announced the launch of its own modular data center called Sonic Inference Pod.

item.title: EON wants to move the data superhighway from ocean fiber to space lasers
item.description: Endeavor Optical Networks is planning to launch the fastest space laser communications system yet built.
